Product Features

  • Headboard with LED Lighting Design: The LED design with white PU fabric is suitable for modern homes, and can also be matched with the design of a game room. The remote control allows you to change the different colors and brightness
  • Hydraulic bar: Great storage space Large bed base below the fold-up slatted frame with plenty of storage space for storing blankets, pillows or bed linen, slatted frame can be easily folded up by lifting cylinder. An Oxford cloth is attached to the bottom of the bed to keep dust out.
  • Textured White Leather: The PU material is waterproof and easy to clean. The white fabric is not monotonous, as the simple white color blends with the texture and highlights the overall texture of the bed.
  • Strong Construction: The slats are attached to the bed frame with Velcro. The additional support legs of the center bar can ensure the reliable stability of the bed. Maximum Load Capacity: 660 LBS
  • Detailed information: The bed has 2 sizes, 140*200cm, 160*200cm. To reduce the risk of damage, the bed frame is shipped in two boxes and can arrive on different days. If both packages have arrived but parts are missing, please contact customer service.
